name: func-invocation-expr-test-adcfe7c191/function-invocation-expr-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16 (no reduce), and ballerina/lang.stream is absent.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (neither array:reduce nor stream:close is listed).
Module-level declarations > Function definition: "Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature".
reason: The invoked testTypeRefTypedRestArg asserts 15 from testFn, which computes its result with the unsupported array reduce langlib method. The invoked nil-return test also creates a stream and calls its unsupported close langlib method. Either essential call makes this whole case a feature request despite supported ordinary, nested, defaultable, rest and remote invocation constructs.
unsupported_constructs: b.reduce(...) in testFn; its reduction result is asserted as 15
testStream.close() in testFuncWithNilReturnTypeWithoutVariableAssignment (lang.stream is not in the supported library list)
test_design_notes: main invokes both affected tests; io:println is output instrumentation and does not drive the classification.
